requirements.text: A visitor can send a message with their name, email and text.
An invalid email address shows an error and nothing is sent.
A confirmation is shown once the message is sent.
If sending fails, the visitor sees an error and their message is kept.

openQuestions.question: Should the form show that it is sending while it waits for the reply?
openQuestions.default: No sending state. The button stays as it is until the reply comes.
